mechanism_description: Beyond supplying Ag+, the NO3- counter-ion can act as a mild oxidant under hydrothermal/precipitation conditions, promoting oxidation of co-precursor cations (e.g., Mn2+, Co2+) or organic reducing agents and thereby influencing the final oxidation state/phase of the product.
